title: Track 1 dashboard hygiene / account source truth

open_issue_scope.note: route_scope already existed from 5ZZF; the list was flat

track1_runtime_panel.before: readable but silent about its blocker source
track1_runtime_panel.after: names the source; legacy/debt explicitly non-blocking

file_location_correction.note: monitor/static/ does not exist; these are the files 5ZZF worked in

the_card_before.all_from: the legacy runner's snapshot dated 2026-08-24 and its own meta.account
the_card_before.one_line: the largest figure on the page was the least current one, and it belonged to a different route
the_card_before.5zzf_fixed: the small print only; the headline was untouched

second_finding_runner_freshness.cause: the freshness label comes from the schedule model, which asks whether a publication was DUE; in track1-only mode the legacy runner is never scheduled, so nothing is ever late and nothing is ever stale
second_finding_runner_freshness.consequence: the page's runner-derived zone dims on that label, so it never dimmed
second_finding_runner_freshness.principle: a freshness model that assumes its producer still runs cannot report a producer that has stopped
second_finding_runner_freshness.action: legacy contract left alone (other panels read it); this card measures staleness from age_seconds past LEGACY_STALE_HOURS = 12
second_finding_runner_freshness.why_12: the legacy runner published daily; one missed publication is a producer that has stopped, not one running late

part_b_source_contract.why_not_the_template: a policy spelled out in string interpolation is a policy nothing can test

new_fields.age_hours: computed at read time from checked_at
new_fields.headline_usable: status in (PASS, WARN) AND a real equity
new_fields.headline_reason: why, in words, when it is not

page_behaviour.usable: headline USD 250,818 with the currency spelled out; sub-line baseline PASS - read 3.7h ago / USD 250,000
page_behaviour.unknown_or_fail: headline says so and STOPS - no fallback

part_b_source_contract.refusal_branch_is_the_point: falling back to the legacy figure is what produced the confusion; a fallback that fires silently is worse than a blank

funded_delta_not_shown_as_gain.why_refused: Track 1 has sent no orders; the difference is whatever the paper account held when funded. A number that will be misread as P&L is not improved by being arithmetically correct.

age_hours_rationale.principle: a description walks away from the thing it describes; a field recomputed on every read cannot

scheduler_chip.why: SCHEDULER reads as a component; the chip answers whose problem this is

part_c_issue_scope.known_debt: joins the legacy group rather than taking a fourth heading
part_c_issue_scope.unrecognised_scope: falls into Shared, where it is visible, rather than out of all three
part_c_issue_scope.panel_row_added: Blockers come from - names the gate registry and says legacy/debt issues do not block Track 1 paper readiness
part_c_issue_scope.why: four of the five open issues are about the legacy route; nothing at panel level said so, so the natural reading was that Track 1 was blocked by five things

part_e_backend_restart.why: the endpoint imports its reader inside the view function, which looks like it picks up code changes per request - Python caches the module, so a backend started before this stage keeps serving the old block
part_e_backend_restart.quiet_window: any - the backend serves the dashboard and reads evidence; it places no orders and holds no trading state

defect_this_exposed_in_my_own_work.what: read naively, headline_usable: null is falsy - the page would have printed 'baseline FAIL' over a funded, reconciled, PASSING account
defect_this_exposed_in_my_own_work.severity: a worse lie than the one this stage set out to fix, appearing the moment the page shipped ahead of a restart
defect_this_exposed_in_my_own_work.fix: the page distinguishes ABSENT from FALSE - absent means derive from what the old block carries; false means the backend decided and its decision stands
defect_this_exposed_in_my_own_work.same_correction_as: Stage 5ZZE, where I inferred from file mtimes that no restart was needed and was wrong. This time the endpoint was asked.

route_label_run_together.measured: not what the page renders - label and value are separate block elements on separate lines; it is what innerText concatenation looks like without the layout

part_d_panel_and_overflow.cause: two white-space: nowrap rules - the headline figure and the note under it - both written when the headline was $50,408 and the note was one figure long
part_d_panel_and_overflow.fix: both wrap below 1100px; the figure shrinks below 560px
part_d_panel_and_overflow.wrapping_not_ellipsis: a truncated money figure still looks like a money figure

residual_17px.belongs_to: a tooltip pseudo-element (.has-tip::after, absolutely positioned, not in querySelectorAll)
residual_17px.how_tested: as a PROPERTY - the Track 1 headline is never wider than the legacy one it replaced - rather than as a literal that would bless the artifact or fail for an unrelated reason

also_fixed.cause: age() already ends in 'ago'; both branches carrying the legacy figure appended a second one
also_fixed.why_nobody_caught_it: no test looked past the number

list: the headline falls back to the stale legacy figure
an absent field is read as a refusal (the version-skew case)
an explicit false is overruled by re-deriving from status
a refused baseline is treated as usable
the shared scope reverts to a component name
the legacy group stops collecting carried debt
the equity card stops wrapping at narrow widths
the legacy return is written back onto the Track 1 card

one_failed_to_go_red_first_time.which: the legacy return is written back onto the Track 1 card
one_failed_to_go_red_first_time.cause: a hole in my TEST DATA, not in the code - the fixture's total_return was null, so both branches rendered '--' and the test agreed with the mutation that deleted the guard
one_failed_to_go_red_first_time.fix: a non-null figure makes the guard provable
one_failed_to_go_red_first_time.note: second stage running where a mutation found a test proving less than its name promised

pins_restated_not_weakened.was: the exact phrase 'legacy runner state still shows'
pins_restated_not_weakened.now: 'Legacy runner state stale:' - it says WHY the figure is not the account, which Part B.5 asked for
invariants_unchanged: nowhere outside its own clause, checked by cutting the clause out and looking again
pins_restated_not_weakened.care_needed: the negative pin CONTAINS the positive one as a substring, so replacing the positive first would have silently rewritten the negative into something that still read plausibly and asserted something else

tests.pre_existing_failures_note: none in any suite this stage ran; the four adjusted pins were adjusted by this stage's own change and nothing was left red
